papers.title: Revisiting Model Stitching to Compare Neural Representations
locators: Page3 main text and Figure2 visually inspected
Page4 Section2, Equation1 and direct-plugging limitation
findings: Stitching risk is defined by an infimum over a specified simple adapter family; the adapter is optimized on training data and evaluated on test data.
The paper warns that direct plugging can fail even for neuron permutations. Our fixed alpha/utility interface avoids an arbitrary latent-value basis swap, but coadaptation remains possible.
No trained adapter or general representation-equivalence conclusion is part of the proposed Q-RMEA diagnostic.
limitations: Only indicated portions of pages1,3,4 read; experiments, appendices and later revisions not audited.
The descriptive crossed replay is not a new stitching method or an estimate of the adapter-optimized infimum.
